title: It's okay. Very short handle, spoon area small
text:
It's okay. Very short handle, spoon area small. You can always use another slotted spoon if you cook very much.

This one is smaller than any slotted spoon I have previously owned. It appears as though the mfg took a small plastic slotted spoon and dipped it in a silicone bath. There is a hole at the end of the handle for hanging.

It won't scratch pans, which is a good thing. But the spoon is just too short to be of much use at the stove. Perhaps it will be more useful as a tabletop serving spoon.
